_comment: P6 Claude fleet controller policy. ENFORCE requires approved_enforce_digest to equal FleetPolicy.digest() AND an --allow-enforce invocation flag. Flipped to enforce under Diego's explicit cutover approval on 2026-09-01; the reaper was retired in the same change (and stayed retired -- see hermes commits b7348d08/dc35ee74 for a brief re-enable and its revert). 2026-09-01 ~19:2xZ: fleet_min_roots lowered 30 -> 25 on Diego's explicit instruction, and approved_enforce_digest RE-APPROVED in the same edit to the new policy digest -- changing any policy field changes digest(), and leaving the old digest would silently demote the controller to shadow on the next pass. Culling still needs BOTH triggers: planner.py sets triggers_armed = fleet_armed and pressure.valid, so a fresh D7 spawn-latency signal is still required; this change only widens the fleet-size half. To roll back: set mode to shadow OR null approved_enforce_digest (either disarms enforcement on the next pass).
